SCRIPT.JAPANESE: ユマンさん お誕生日おめでとう〜

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: You’ve worked so hard by my side all this time!
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 这段时间在我身边辛苦啦！
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 這段時間在我身邊辛苦啦！
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 今まで隣で頑張ってくれてありがとう！
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Kamu udah kerja keras banget di sampingku selama ini!
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Você tem trabalhado muito duro ao meu lado todo esse tempo.
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Has trabajado muy duro junto a mí, todo este tiempo.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: تو تمام این مدت در کنار من سخت کار کردی!

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Let’s keep it up from here on too!
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: これからもよろしくね！
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Yuk terus bareng-bareng ke depannya juga!
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: از اینجا به بعد هم ادامه بدیم!

SCRIPT.JAPANESE: ありがとうございます 課長

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: I’ll take care of your birthday next year too.
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 明年生日我也会帮你准备的
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 明年生日我也會幫你準備的
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 来年の誕生日も私が祝ってあげる
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Tahun depan, aku yang urus ulang tahunmu juga, ya.
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Eu vou cuidar do seu aniversário no ano que vem também.
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Me encargaré de tu cumpleaños el próximo año, también.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: سال آینده هم از تولدت مراقبت خواهم کرد.

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Next time, I’ll even take a day off for it...
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Next time, aku bahkan bakal ambil cuti khusus...
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Da próxima vez… vou tirar o dia de folga e…
SCRIPT.SPANISH: La próxima vez… tomaré el día libre y…
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: دفعه بعد حتی یک روز مرخصی میگیرم...

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: This is my way of saying thanks~
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: これは俺からのお返しです〜
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Essa é a minha forma de dizer obrigada~
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Este es mi forma de decir gracias~
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: این روش من برای تشکر است

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Yuman, are you messing around right now?
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 吴宥万，你现在是在开玩笑吗？
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 吳宥萬，你現在是在開玩笑嗎？
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: ウ・ユマンさん 今ふざけてます？
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Yuman, kamu lagi ngelawak sekarang ya?
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Yumán, o que você tá fazendo?

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: I’m sorry. I just got a little too excited.
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: すみません ちょっと浮かれてました
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Maaf... aku cuma agak kegirangan aja.
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Lo siento, me emocioné un poco.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: متاسفم فقط کمی بیش از حد هیجان زده شدم.

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Don’t pull stunts like that again.
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: こういう冗談はやめなさい
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Jangan ngelakuin hal aneh-aneh kayak gitu lagi.
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Não faça mais esse tipo de brincadeira.
SCRIPT.SPANISH: No vuelvas a hacer ese tipo de bromas.
